title: Choose a message
summary: Lua: Choose a message. Try score 3. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: if checks a condition. then starts its steps and end closes them.

blocks.text: Install Lua 5.3 or 5.4. Save each example as lesson.lua and run lua lesson.lua.

blocks.title: Choose a message
blocks.code:
local score = 8
if score >= 5 then
 print("Pass")
else
 print("Try again")
end

blocks.text: The condition is true for 8. The first block prints Pass.
